text:
Type: woven rattan plant pot
Use: covering a grower pot for a large floor plant; living room, home office, dining room
Style: bohemian, Japandi, coastal
Materials: hand-woven rattan in natural and dark grey stained strands, wrapped handles
Colors: natural beige, dark grey, two-tone
Shape: tall rounded bucket that narrows toward the base, diagonal two-tone weave, two cut-out handles below the rim, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, textured, relaxed, warm
Goes with: tall leafy plants, light wood, linen, white walls; bohemian, Japandi or coastal rooms

product.name: RGKORN
product.description: A plastic inner pot makes the plant pot waterproof.
